quest.title: The Arrival of a...!
quest.description: Mr. Petit Lumiere seems to have a unique understanding of films...

dialogues.speaker: Petit Lumiere
dialogues.text: Someone as famous as you... I bet people are always handing you their business cards.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh... You know us? {NICKNAME}, this kid's pretty sophisticated.

dialogues.speaker: Petit Lumiere
dialogues.text: Holding another in contempt merely on account of their lack of years is a mistake only the most ignorant would make. I suspect the two of you are not quite so shallow as that.

dialogues.speaker: Petit Lumiere
dialogues.text: I didn't intend to flatter myself, but my elder brother and I are famous local film directors. Everyone calls me Mr. Petit Lumiere.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Correct! I am quite keen on learning more about your adventuring experiences. In my industry, extraordinary stories are always in demand.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: As you appear not to be well acquainted with me, allow me to introduce myself.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: My elder brother and I have been working together to produce films for quite some time, and have already had quite a few blockbuster successes. Perhaps you've seen "Employees Leaving the Factory"...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nope.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Oh, that's okay. How about "The Arrival of an Aquabus"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haven't seen it either.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Ah, I see...

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: ...That is nothing too remarkable. The road to fame and stardom upon which we two brothers tread is yet long, and we will certainly make even more popular films in the future.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Film production, constructing and planning narratives, the performances of actors, the cooperation between cameraman and director, and post-production and processing... All of it is a truly fascinating process.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: And among all these, I believe that the process of filming itself is the most technically demanding.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: What you choose to focus on while filming decides the information that will be conveyed to the audience, the atmosphere they will feel...

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Of course, the narration is very important, but you cannot expect a story to rely on narration alone.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Four shots! I've always believed that you only need four shots to construct the smallest divisible unit of a story.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Within just these four shots, a genius can work miracles.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Would the two of you like to try? Seize this opportunity to revel in the glamor and charm of filmmaking!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, what should we do?

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: It is simple! I will provide you with a few simple themes that have already been formulated into short scenes.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: The important thing is to try out different ways of handling both the narration and the Kamera, and combining them to film a few short scenes. Are the two of you interested?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Our interest has been piqued.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Marvelous! Then, once the two of you are ready, you may go to the filming locations I have already prepared. I will give you feedback on your finished products.

choices.text: Do you plan on giving us your business card as well?
